Paragraphe · Dinowax® Qwik is a hybrid ceramic micro-
blocks_element.text:
Dinowax® Qwik is a hybrid ceramic micro-emulsion that is spray applied directly to clean or lightly soiled paint surfaces. Simply spray and wipe for incredible shine, gloss, paint color enhancement and water repellent beading effects. 
Qwik produces a noticeably darker, enhanced shade to the paint surface.  Instantaneously reversing years of UV oxidation.  Not just a temporary surface treatment, Qwik is formulated with a proprietary reactive hybrid ceramic micro-emulsion technology that will last through multiple wash cycles.  Apply universally, to paint, chrome and glass.  Wipe clean to a streak-free, water repellent shine.
